title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDC-Margined ENA, ETHFI, and 1000BONK Perpetual Contracts With Up to 50x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience,  Binance Futures will launch the  ENAUSDC  Perpetual Contract at  2024-05-02 07:00 (UTC),  ETHFIUSDC  Perpetual Contract at  2024-05-02 07:15 (UTC)  and  1000BONKUSDC  Perpetual Contract at  2024-05-02 07:30 (UTC) ,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the aforementioned perpetual contracts can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts ENAUSDC ETHFIUSDC 1000BONKUSDC Launch Time 2024-05-02 07:00 (UTC) 2024-05-02 07:15 (UTC) 2024-05-02 07:30 (UTC) Underlying Asset Ethena (ENA) ether.fi (ETHFI) Bonk (BONK) Settlement Asset USDC USDC USDC Tick Size 0.0001 0.0001 0.000001 Capped Funding Rate +2.0000% / -2.0000% +2.0000% / -2.0000% +2.0000% / -2.0000% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x 50x 50x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Supported Please Note:  Starting from  2024-04-03 12:30 (UTC) ,   users will enjoy  zero maker fees  and a  0.017% taker fee  for  all trades on USDC-margined futures contracts .   Refer to this  announcement  for more information. Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned futures contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contracts.  The aforementioned perpetual contracts are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.
